'''Ultrasonic showers''' were a type of [[Shower/Legends|shower]], similar to the [[Sonic shower/Legends|sonic shower]], used for personal hygiene. The [[refresher booth]]s produced by [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]] included a fully contained and automated ultrasonic shower, which incorporated [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] into the wash.<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ultrasonic shower was first shown as buyable equipment in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a sourcebook released in [[1995]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GFT" />
